text: phusatisuttaṃ [58] nāphusantaṃ phusati ca phusantañca tato phuse tasmā phusantaṃ phusati appaduṭṭhapadosinanti . [59] yo appaduṭṭhassa narassa dussati suddhassa posassa anaṅgaṇassa tameva bālaṃ pacceti pāpaṃ sukhumo rajo paṭivātaṃva khittoti . #1 sī. ma. sabbattha ḍayhamānovāti pāṭho dissati . 2 sī. ma. kāmarāgappahānena . tatiyaṃ
